allowlist_policy: Closed by default. Training requires explicit new approved source IDs, outside every excluded family. No challenge-derived text, images, answers, or failures.
excluded_families: existing eval fixtures and all their source material
group_policy: Whole captures only. Stable participant and cross-capture physical IDs unavailable; exclude the entire ambiguous Objectron family from training.
enforcement: Lead must give builders this exclusion contract rather than evaluator answers. Future source allowlists require reviewer approval.
